questions.q: Which of the following diseases is caused by a protozoan?
questions.qPa: ਹੇਠ ਲਿਖਿਆਂ ਵਿੱਚੋਂ ਕਿਹੜੀ ਬਿਮਾਰੀ ਪ੍ਰੋਟੋਜ਼ੋਆ ਕਾਰਨ ਹੁੰਦੀ ਹੈ?
questions.explanation: Malaria is caused by the Plasmodium protozoan.

questions.q: Tuberculosis is primarily caused by which type of organism?
questions.explanation: TB is caused by the Mycobacterium tuberculosis bacterium.

questions.q: The female Anopheles mosquito acts as a vector for which disease?
questions.explanation: The female Anopheles mosquito transmits the malaria parasite.

questions.q: Measles and Polio are examples of diseases caused by:
questions.explanation: Both are highly contagious viral infections.
Typhoid is a waterborne/foodborne bacterial disease.

questions.q: Diseases that can be passed from one person to another are called:
questions.explanation: Communicable or infectious diseases can spread between hosts.

questions.q: Which is the most effective method for preventing viral diseases like Polio and Measles?
questions.explanation: Vaccines train the immune system to fight viruses.

questions.q: Which pathogen type is treated using antibiotics?
questions.explanation: Antibiotics kill or inhibit the growth of bacteria, not viruses.
